aboutText: With a decade of experience, A1 Complete Tile Removal has become the trusted choice for tile removal in Sunshine, VIC. We handle everything from small bathroom tiles to large commercial flooring, ensuring minimal disruption and maximum satisfaction. Our professional team uses state-of-the-art equipment to deliver clean and timely results.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive tile removal solutions tailored to your needs. From residential homes to commercial properties, our expert team ensures efficient and safe removal of all tile types.

services.title: Residential Tile Removal
services.desc: We remove tiles from homes, including bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas, with minimal mess and disruption to your daily life.

services.title: Commercial Tile Removal
services.desc: Our team handles large-scale tile removal for offices, shops, and warehouses, ensuring quick turnaround to keep your business operational.

services.title: Floor Grinding & Preparation
services.desc: After tile removal, we grind and prepare the floor surface, making it ready for new flooring installation with a smooth finish.

services.title: Adhesive & Mortar Removal
services.desc: We specialise in removing stubborn adhesive and mortar residues, leaving your floor clean and prepared for the next step.

services.title: Tile & Slate Removal
services.desc: Expert removal of all types of tiles, including ceramic, porcelain, and slate, using the right tools for each material.

services.title: Underlay & Subfloor Removal
services.desc: We also remove old underlay and damaged subfloors, ensuring a solid foundation for your new flooring project.
